fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2025-10-27 states that a dual-SIM handset of the complainant went missing after a brief push in a crowded stretch at Alli Park Shopping Complex in Salem, on 2025-10-27 at about 18:05. Contact details given by the complainant, Chithra Ammal, include the number 9000000016. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Arun Babu, using the number 9000000379. Anitha Raman was mentioned as a person who was present nearby, but no contact number was available. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly approached from behind and took the phone before leaving the spot.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, mobile number, call detail, shopping complex, evening, suspect, witness
